thread:
maria: FYI found a staging backup object uploaded by partner that contains a GCP service account key (wrapped). path: `gs://partner-backups/staging/2026-03-23/backup-az3f.json.gz`. file is KMS-wrapped ciphertext but the SA email is visible: redwood-staging-backup-sa@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com. treat as compromised and rotate.

jamal: can you confirm whether the blob is plaintext or wrapped? if wrapped we need to know which KMS key and who can unwrap.

maria: looks wrapped. metadata shows `projects/partner-project/locations/global/keyRings/backups/cryptoKeys/wrap-2025`. partner-managed key.

sec-bot: alert: sensitive_artifact_upload detected matching SA key pattern. severity: medium. detected: 2026-03-23T15:40:12Z.

ops-oncall: creating incident SOM-2026-119. containment steps: 1) restrict object ACLs 2) snapshot object to evidence bucket (read-only) 3) request partner KMS audit logs 4) start SA key rotation in staging.

lina: @maria any runtimes or CI using that SA? need immediate key deletes if referenced.

maria: grep shows two infra references in staging terraform state and one CI job `ci/staging-snapshot`. no prod references.

aj: proposed plan: 1) ticket + snapshot (ops-oncall) 2) ask partner for decrypt/unwarp audit and list of principals with unwrap perms 3) create new SA, update TF/CI, revoke old keys 4) revoke any tokens tied to SA 5) sweep repos/artifacts for similar leaks 6) schedule RBAC review for partner KMS grants.

jamal: note: rotating partner KMS key won't affect wrapped blobs we don't control; assume anyone with Unwrap can get plaintext. priority is SA rotation and CI invalidation. ask partner to temporarily remove broad unwrap grants.

maria: pinged partner-sec (cc). asked them to block wide `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` on the key and to provide: - Cloud Audit Logs for the key for last 90 days - IAM members who have decrypt/unwrap permissions - any service accounts that invoked decrypt API recently.

partner-sec: received. will pull logs and list principals. will block broad decrypt roles temporarily and report back within 2 hours.

ops-oncall: tasks assigned: - ops-oncall: create SOM-2026-119 + attach snapshot (in progress) - jamal: rotation script & tf updates (ETA 2h) - aj: KMS audit request text + rollback plan (ETA 1h) - maria: artifact scan (ETA 30m) - lina: CI key invalidation + redeploy (ETA 45m).

lina: CI invalidation snippet: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=redwood-staging-backup-sa@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com` then `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEY_ID` and redeploy `ci/staging-snapshot` with new creds.

jamal: also running `rg "redwood-staging-backup-sa@" -S` across infra repos and checks for TF state references for planned state migration.

maria: will add a tfstate patch to the ticket to avoid drift during rotation.

aj: partner ask bullets for their team: - provide Cloud KMS audit logs (decrypt/unwrap) for `wrap-2025` cryptoKey for last 90 days - list principals with `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` or `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on that key - confirm if any groups grant external principals access - rotate the wrap key if wide-unwrapped access is found.

sec-bot: reminder: attach all comms and evidence to SOM-2026-119 channel and evidence bucket.

partner-sec: pulling logs now, will share a CSV of decrypt events and IAM bindings snapshot.

ops-oncall: marking incident as contained (staging only) pending partner audit. next steps after partner response: rotate SA keys, update CI, request partner rotate their wrap key if they had broad unwrap grants, and run RBAC hardening across partners.

lina: suggestion: require partner KMS audit forwarding or a key-access SLA so we get near-real-time unwrap alerts. we should add this to vendor onboarding requirements.

aj: +1. add to vendor onboarding checklist: KMS audit forwarding to our SIEM or periodic audit exports and minimum-granularity unwrap alerts.

maria: collecting evidence and attaching to SOM-2026-119. ping if you need anything else. :pray:
